units.source_text: 在艺术上，托喀也有自己独有的见解。

en.t: In art, Tok also had his own distinctive views.

units.source_text: 在他眼里，艺术不被任何支配，要为了艺术而艺术。

en.t: In his eyes, art was subject to nothing and had to exist for art's sake.

units.source_text: 因此艺术家必须是超越善恶的超人。

en.t: Therefore an artist had to be a superman beyond good and evil.

units.source_text: 这不光是托喀的想法，也是跟托喀一伙的诗人们的想法。

en.t: This was not only Tok's idea, but also the idea of the poets who belonged to his circle.

units.source_text: 我就常常跟托喀一起超人俱乐部玩。

en.t: I often went with Tok to spend time at the Superman Club.

units.source_text: 诗人、小说家、戏剧家、评论家、画家、音乐家、雕刻家和其他艺术的业余爱好者都聚在这里谈论，都是超人。

en.t: Poets, novelists, playwrights, critics, painters, musicians, sculptors, and other amateur lovers of art all gathered here to talk, and all of them were supermen.

units.source_text: 灯光明亮的客厅里，总有他们愉快交谈的身影。

en.t: In the brightly lit drawing room, one could always see them chatting cheerfully.

units.source_text: 偶尔还会互相炫耀彼此的超人本领。

en.t: At times they would even show off their superhuman abilities to one another.

units.source_text: 比如，曾经就有个雌性小说家为了显示自己的超人本领，就站在桌子上喝了六十瓶艾酒，

en.t: For example, once a female novelist, in order to display her superhuman ability, stood on a table and drank sixty bottles of absinthe,

units.source_text: 但是喝到第六十瓶的时候，她就滚到桌子底下彻底完蛋了。

en.t: but when she reached the sixtieth bottle, she rolled under the table and was completely done for.
